guiding_symptoms:
-"Tarantism" is the term applied to the dancing mania set up in a person bitten by the tarentula; the cure is music and dancing.

-Adapted to highly nervous organisms, especially choleric affections, where whole body or right arm and left leg are affected.

-Restlessness, could not keep quiet in any position, must keep in motion though walking < all symptoms.

-Constant movement of the legs, arm, trunk, with inability to do anything. Twitching and jerking of muscles.

-Symptoms appear suddenly with violence.

-Violent pains, neuralgias, as if thousands of  needles were pricking.

-At every menstrual cycle, throat, mouth and tongue intolerably dry, especially when sleeping.

-Symptom appear periodically.

-Head-Headache neuralgic < by noise touch, strong light > by rubbing head against the pillow.

-Headache intense, as if thousands of needles were pricking, wants hair pulled or head rubbed.

-G.I.T.-Craving for sand or raw food, salt, spicy.

-Aversion to meat, bread.

-Bitter eructation.

-Respiratory system-Attacks of suffocation with crying, screaming and restlessness, must have fresh air.

-Coughing < after coition noise > smoking.

-Male genitalia-Hyper-sexual patients, promiscuity.

-Female genitalia-Sexual excitement extreme, even to mania.

-Spasms of uterus.

-Pruritus vulvae become intolerable, especially after menses.

-Vulvae dry and hot.

-At every menstrual cycle, throat, mouth and tongue intolerably dry.

-Profuse menses with erotic spasms.

-Sensation of motion in uterus like a foetus or burning.

-Tumours and diseases of the ovaries.

-C.V.S.-Palpitations. Precordial anguish.

-Sensation as if heart were twisted and turned around.

-Angina pectoris.

-Mitral valve disease.

-C.N.S.-Twitches and jerks. Chorea.

-Hyperaesthesia. Formication.

-Pins and needles sensation.

-Back-Painfully sensitive spine, touch excites pain in chest, heart, etc.

-Coccygodynia > standing < slightest movement < touch.

-Extremities-Weakness of legs. Restless legs.

-Choreic movements.

-Numbness of legs.

-Multiple sclerosis with trembling.

-Twitching and jerking.

-Yawning with uneasiness of legs, must move them constantly.

-Extraordinary contraction and movements.

-Restless arms, must keep hands busy.

-Sleep-Sleepless before midnight, from excitement.

-Dreams sad, with weeping.

-Skin-Purplish ecchymosed spots.

-Abscess, boils, felons.

-Affected parts of bluish colour and atrocious burning pain. The agony of pain compelling patient to walk the floor for nights.

-Formication.

-Dry eczema.

-Itching as of insects creeping crawling.

mind_symptoms:
-Aversion to strong colours- black, red, yellow, green.

-Dances up and down, erratic impulsive.

-Fits of nervous laughter, then screaming.

-Moral depravity. Lacks control.

-Suddenly changing moods, fancies, or strength.

-Crafty, cunning, dishonest, selfish, destructive, destroys whatever she can lay hand on, tears her clothes, etc.

-Hateful, throws things away. Malingering.

-Hysteria.

-When attention is directed to her, she begins to twitch, feigns, fainting. Sensibility, but looks sideways to observe the effect on those around her.

-Desires to strike herself or others.

-Aversion to being touched.

-Kleptomania, laughs, mocks run, dances, gesticulates, jokes, cries, sings till hoarse or exhausted.

-Death agony. Angry, despair, melancholy, discontented.

-Mental symptoms > p.m. after eating.

-Rolls on ground from side to side or strikes vehemently or rolls the head and rubs it to relieve her distress.

-Hurried, intense, excited and restless. Impatient.

-Can run better than walk.

-Increased strength during the manic episode.

-Sensitive to music. Loves music and dancing.

-Laughing and wildness.

-Aversion to company, but wants someone present.

-Industrious. Works at a very good pace.

-Tremendous restlessness, better from exertion.

key_symptoms:
1. Unbroken chilblains with excessive itching pulsations.

2. Pain excites urination.

3. Tongue-dry, red, sore, shining, burning at tip, with prominent papillae.

4. Enormous distension of abdomen.

5. Urine-smoky, of coffee ground sediment, or thick yellow slimy muddy sediment, painless with odour of violets.

6. Stands with feet apart, has no power of balancing the body.

7. Walks bent like an old man, as if pitched forward while walking.

8. Cold perspiration mainly of lower extremities.

-Inflammation of kidneys with haemorrhage.

-Congestion in the renal pelvis causing urine to be uniformly mixed with blood - a smoky appearance of urine.

-Inflammation of the intestines, causing tympanitis and soreness of the abdomen with diarrhoea.

Bleeding mucous surfaces-dark passive, foetid.

Tmpanites and urinary symtoms.

Inflammation of kidneys, with haemorrhages.

Strangury, with bloody urine.
guiding_symptoms:
-Haemorrhages-Passive, black, offensive, oozing from mucous membrane.

-Purpura haemorrhagica, fresh ecchymoses in great numbers from day to day [Sul-ac].

-Aching soreness and stiffness of muscles.

-Pain-excites urination
-along large nerves < damp weather
-sensation of coldness in nerves or occasionally like hot water running through a tube.

-Tongue-dry, red, sore, SHINING, burning at tip with prominent papillae [Arg-n, Bell, Kali-bi, Nux-m].

-Tongue does not clean gradually, but rapidly in large flakes, first from middle leaving tongue smooth and glossy as if deprived of papillae [Pyrogen, Crot-h].

-G.I.T.-Aversion to meat.

-Flatulence. Enormous distension of abdomen.

-Bruised soreness of abdomen, extremely sensitive to touch.

-Diarrhoea-stool, watery, greenish, mucous, frequent, profuse, foetid, bloody, burning in anus and rectum.

-Fainting and exhaustion [Ars] after every stool.

-Worms with foul breath, choking [Cina, Spig] dry, hacking cough, tickling at anus, ascarides, lumbrici, tapeworm segments passed.

-Urinary system-Strangury, bloody urine.

-Cutting and burning in bladder, tenesmus.

-Haematuria; blood thoroughly mixed with urine.

-Urine scanty or suppressed, ODOUR OF VIOLETS.

-Urine smoky, of coffee ground sediment or thick, yellow, slimy, muddy sediment, painless.

-Albuminuria after diphtheria, scarlatina, typhoid.

-Albuminuria in early stages when blood and albumin abound more than casts or epithelium.

-Burning pain in region of kidneys, ureter, bladder [Berb, Cann-s, Canth].

-Nephritis after exanthemata and violent bronchitis.

-Nephritis following an acute disease.

-Kidneys affected along with rheumatism.

-Ascites with anasarca in organic disease of the kidney.

-Female genitalia-Intense burning in uterine region.

-Uterine disease after wearing pessaries.

-Extremities-Stands with feet apart, has no power of balancing body.

-Walks bent like an old man, as if pitched forward while walking.

-Cold perspiration mainly of lower extremities [Morrison].

-Fever-Typhoid with tympanitis and haemorrhage.

guiding_symptoms:
-Persons of light complexion, blue eyes, blonde, tall, slim, narrow chest, with fine and long eyelashes.

-Symptoms are constantly changing.

-Deep brain headaches.

-Acute, cerebral or basilar meningitis, with threatened effusion, with nocturnal hallucinations.

-Long fine eyelashes.

-Ears-Perforation of membrana tympani with ragged edges.

-Sensation of suffocation, even with plenty of fresh air.

-Tuberculosis begins in apex of lungs, especially left lung (Phos, Sulph).

-Female genitalia-Menses too early, too profuse, too long lasting.

-Benign mammary tumours.

-Dysmenorrhoea with pains increased with establishment of flow.

-Male genitalia-Hyper-sexual. Promiscuity.

-Early or excessive masturbation.

-Back-Dark or long, fine hair on back of children, along the spine.

-Extremities-Acute articular rheumatism.

-Good remedy for bony suppurations.

-Skin-Dry, harsh skin with itching profound.

-Crops of small boils which are intensely foetid, with green foetid pus.

-Eczema with  intense itching < night when undressing, bathing.

-White bran like scales; oozing in the folds of skin.

-Hair-plica polonica.

-Ringworm.

key_symptoms:
1. Over enthusiastic in supporting a good cause.

2. Great consciousness of mission.

3. Self-discipline and restraint, idealistic.

4. Passionate protagonist.

5. Highly strung and even fanatical, unable to relax.

6. Very intense, focusing too strongly.

7. Eagerness to overdo things, very involved in their work.

8. Tense and nervous inside, difficult to relax.

9. They are revolutionaries at heart, radiate their energy on to others.

10. They are flooded with great deal of positive energy at times.

11. Irritable and nervous when things do not progress as well as expected.

12. Have firm principles and wants to convince others as to their rightness.

13. Tells others how to do things, acting for them, trying to force them into what is good for them.

14. Incensed by injustices.

15. Courageous, accepting risks.

16. Hyperactive children.

Over-enthusiasm. Over-busyness. Hastiness. Goads himself to do through his will power, much more than what his physical strength would permit. If he has an idea, he not only sticks to it through thick and thin, but wants to propagate it amongst others. He overstrains himself in impressing upon others the uniqueness and the utility of his idea. In his over-enthusiasm to do over-work, he fails to give periodical rest to his human machine, which may cause complete breakdown of his physical and mental health due to constant strain and tension.

key_symptoms:
1. Its needed mostly in special life situations where major changes are about to take place and there is increased stress and inner instability due to the same.

2. Difficulties of adjusting in transition periods of life.

3. The remedy for those who have decided to take a great step forward in life, to break old conventions, to leave old limits and restrictions and start on a new way.

4. Wants to resist powerful influences and follow one's own true ambitions.

5. Useful in situations such as, after retirement, after a stroke or following some illness, a major change in life style, on attempting to start new work, during divorce proceedings.

6. Normally knows exactly what one wants, but now tends to vacillate in a specific new situation.

7. Finally wants to be really clear in mind concerning a change.

The link-breaker. When a man wants to take some major decisions, like change in profession or business, divorce, change of religion, etc, many impediments are put in his way by his elders and well-wishers and he is dissuaded by convincing arguments from many quarters. It helps to overcome old habits, superstitions, community rules, old vices like drinking, smoking, gambling, etc. When physical changes occur in the body, as at the time of teething, puberty, pregnancy, menopause etc, the body suffers. Force is required to effect change in the state of inertia. Walnut provides such force which assists in breaking old links and enables the person to fulfill his mission unhampered in soul and spirit.

key_symptoms:
1. They present an image of great wisdom, unobtrusive superiority and calm sovereignty.

2. They may appear unapproachable and unassailable to others.

3. They possess above average abilities and high degree of individuality.

4. They feel isolated from their fellows and they suddenly feel the need to withdraw completely from the world.

5. Proud withdrawal, feeling of superiority in isolation.

6. Others find it difficult to break through their highly personal barrier, yet they are always asked for advice.

7. On principle, they do not interfere in the affairs of others and do not want to be disturbed themselves.

8. The personality gets more and more frozen to its environment and also to itself.

9. They prefer to deal with their own problems.

10. Rarely cries, endeavours to keep stiff upper lip.

11. In their work, they are calm, conscientious and use their tact in their actions.

12. The only thing they find hard is to make harsh decisions, for they are always aware of the situation of everybody being involved.

13. They are an island of peace, calm and confident.

14. They progress through life with a kind of grace and inner dignity.

Aloofness. Capable and efficient people like pioneers and inventors keep themselves away from society. It is the very nature of their mind to work alone. They do not want to be disturbed when working alone and they do not disturb others in their work. The specialized work which they do without the aid or advise from others sometimes induces in them a sort of superiority complex. Then they may suffer from physical diseases such as of joints, mental rigidity and tension.

-Affecting nervous system causing PARALYSING symptoms, especially HEMIPLEGIA.

-Grinding, shooting, radiating, sudden pains, neuralgias.

-Chronic obstinate cough (Sep, Med).

-Indigestion from overeating or from too much fluid.

-Abdomen- Dysentery with tympanites.

-Female-Neuralgic DYSMENORRHOEA with violent grinding agonising pain in BACK AND DOWN LEGS.

-Menses-too early, too painful, thick, almost black.

-(Left) ovarian neuralgia extending down the thighs, along the genito-crural nerves.

-AFTER PAINS (Arn, Cupr, Cham).

-Paralysis of LEFT side with numbness of spinal origin.

-Sciatica in hot weather.

-Neuralgic shooting pain, as from electricity, all over limbs.

-Sleep-Hard and unrefreshing. Sleeplessness in neurasthenics.
all_sections.NUCLEUS OF REMEDY: -Persons of spare habit or nervous delicate organisation, with neurasthenia, poor assimilation, insomnia, etc. Its specific action is in on the nervous system and mucous membranes.
all_sections.CONFIRMATORY SYMPTOMS: -Neuralgic dysmenorrhoea with pain in back and down legs.
all_sections.CLINICAL:
-Neuralgic dysmenorrhoea. After pains.

-Bleeding in cases that have had cancerous cysts removed surgically in women (Dr. Ferris).

-Anterior crural neuralgia. Scaitica.

-Hemiplegia.

-Tympanites.
all_sections.REMEDY RELATIONSHIPS: Compare : Bry, Cact, Caul, Cham, Cimic, Coloc, Gnaph, Ign, Ph-ac, Puls, Sang, Stict, Vib.

key_symptoms:
1. Dull pain in the right upper jaw. (Prosopalgia).

2. Imaginary and real odors of sulphur.

3. Sneezing with SENSATION OF SULPHUR VAPORS.

4. Congestion of blood to the root of the nose.

5. Sensation of fullness in the ear. Buzzing, ringing, noises in the ear. Pain behind the ear.

6. Cataract. Opacity of the lens. Pain in the eye aggravated by touch. Ulceration of the cornea.

7. Bursting in the head, warm water application ameliorates. Left sided temporal headaches. Dull pressing stitching pain in the head.

8. Pain in the kidney region. Suppression of urine. Tenesmus of bladder.

9. Stools green coloured. Itching of the anus with constipation.

10. Fermentation in the abdomen with nausea.

11. Cramp in the side of the neck aggravated from lifting the head from the pillow. Stiffness of sides of neck aggravated at night.

12. Sensation as if throat is in a long narrow body. Hollow feeling in the throat as if pharynx had disappeared. 

13. Difficult swallowing with pain in the throat on swallowing. Pain in the left side of the tonsils. Sensation of sulphur vapors in the throat.

14. Gray green discolouration of the teeth, with gray green mucus on the teeth.

15. Dryness of the tongue with soreness and pain and roughness.

16. Wandering pain in the right side of the chest. Sensation as if water drops trickling down inside of the chest.

17. Sensation as if heart is enlarged. Extra systole.

18. Inflammation of the lungs, mammae and pericardium.

19. Milk absent.

20. Palpitations of the heart with cough. Greenish viscid expectoration. Paroxysmal cough with hoarseness. Necrosis of cartilages of larynx.

21. Ailments during climacteric period. Greenish leucorrhoea. 

22. Green and profuse bleeding during menses or absent menses in young girls.

23. Sterility.

24. Tumours of uterus; fibroids.

25. Shrivelled and atrophied testis.

26. Sexual desire absent or diminished or wanting.

27. Gleety discharge from urethra as a result of suppression.

28. Aversion to meat in men.

29. Anaemia. Leukaemia.

30. BURNS FROM X-RAYS.

31. CACHEXIA, CANCEROUS AFFECTIONS.

32. AGGRAVATIONS FROM SUPPRESSED ERUPTIONS.

33. Lack of vital heat.

34. Suppressed gonorrhoea.

35. Tendency to haemorrhages, blood does not coagulate. Haemophilia.

36. Desires sweets.

37. Lack of physical irritability. Lack of reaction.

38. Electric like shocks.

39. Ailments from or aggravation from exposure to sun.

40. External and internal trembling.

41. Tuberculosis. Lupus vulgaris.

42. Tendency to weariness.

43. Wounds from X-rays heal slowly. Painful cracks and fissures of the skin.

44. Eruptions of all kinds; Psoriasis, eczema, papular vesicular, pimples with itching.

45. Unhealthy skin; every scratch festers or heals with great difficulty. Dry, wrinkled, shrivelled skin. Warts.

46. Sleeplessness from sounds of heart when lying on left side.

47. Unrefreshed sleep.

48. Pain in the right hip and left calf aggravated by walking. Sciatica walking aggravates.

49. Rushing of blood to and between the fingers. Red discolouration of the fingers and around the nails.

50. Arthritic swelling of joints.

51. Cracked skin of the hands, of tips of fingers and between fingers.

52. Electric current like sensation of arms and hands.

53. Cracking of joints.

54. Eruptions like bran on hands and palms. Psoriasis and scaly eruptions of the palms and hands. Brittle, in growing, thick, 
thin, deformed and falling of nails.

55. Roughness of palms of hands. Smoothness of palms of hands.

56. Trembling after exertion.

57. Perspiration suppressed.

- Re-establishes suppressed gonorrhoea.

- Sterility, atrophy of testes and ovaries.

key_symptoms:
1. Face expression sickly.

2. HICCOUGH DURING YELLOW FEVER.

3. NAUSEA ON THINKING OF WATER.

4. FLUSHES OF HEAT OF THE ABDOMEN WITH COLDNESS OF LIMBS.

5. SUPPRESSION OF URINE WITH VOMITING.

6. HAIR OF THE EYEBROWS WHITE.

7. VERTIGO STAGGERING ON ASCENDING STAIRS AND IN NARROW PLACES.

8. TASTE SWEETISH, SWEETS TASTE TOO SWEET.

9. NODOSITIES ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE TONGUE COMING TO A POINT. PAIN IN THE MOUTH ON CONTRACTING THE ANTERIOR RIGHT HALF OF THE TONGUE. IRREGULAR ULCERS ON THE TONGUE.

10. COUGH:AN ICE CREAM FIRST AMELIORATES THEN AGGRAVATES 9 A.M. - 10 A.M., from irritation of upper air passage. Gasping respiration, impending obstruction.

11. SUPERFICIAL ULCERS AND PUSTULES ON THE GLANS PENIS AND THE PENIS, haemorrhage FROM THE PREPUCE.

12. SKIN DARK BROWN, LIVER SPOTS.

13. PAIN IN ARM AFTER CHILL.

14. PAIN IN THE HOLLOW OF KNEE FROM RISING .

15. DRAWING / STITCHING PAIN IN UPPER LIMBS DURING CHILLS.

16. SPLINTER AS IF UNDER THE NAIL OF THIRD TOE.

17. CHILLINESS OF RIGHT BIG TOE.

18. DISCOLOURATION OF FINGERS / SECOND JOINT OF MIDDLE FINGER.

19. LAMENESS IN THE KNEE WHILE KNEELING.

20. TEARING PAIN IN THE CERVICAL REGION DURING CHILL.

21. Collapse from cholera. Pulse rapid and elevated.

22. Dryness of the tongue. Extreme thirst.

23. Burning pain in the stomach. Stiffness of abdomen.

24. Burning pain in the region of kidneys during urge to urinate. Congestion and fatty degeneration of the kidneys.

25. Discharge from nose are excoriating. Nose:numbness, cold, bloody discharge, violent sneezing and itching and rawness inside the nose.

26. Old looking face, drawn and yellow discolouration.

27. Teeth pain better by external warmth.

28. Constriction and tightness of the chest. Sudden sharp and cutting pain in the left side of the chest, wandering pains.

29. Urine:Black like ink, bloody and sediment (hemoglobinuria).

30. Perspiration at night before sleep and colliquative.

31. Yellow fever.

32. Sleepiness difficult to open the eyes. Sleeplessness:Chronic, during heat.

33. Pain in the hip < while walking. Aching in the lumbar region.

34. Twitching in the shoulder.

35. Coldness in hollow of knee. Weakness of the knee.

36. All symptoms appear suddenly and develop slowly.

37. Appetite wanting.

38. Anaemia. Blood disorganization of.

39. Bright's disease, albuminous urine.

40. Fainting tendency.

41. Aversion:tobacco. Sensitive to odour of tobacco.

42. Lack of vital heat and upward flushes of heat.

43. Haemorrhage tendency to, blood does not coagulate and passive bleeding.

44. Lassitude tendency.

45. Periodicity every seventh day.

46. Soreness better by motion.

47. Pulse soft, small, weak, irregular.

48. Trickling sensation like drops.

49. Weakness:sudden, < after dinner, from headache and on waking.

50. Hiccough after eructation.

51. Retching and gagging after drinking.

52. Thirstlessness during heat.

53. Vomiting:immediately of everything after eating food, after drinking smallest quantity, coffee coloured, bloody or bilious.

54. Constriction and burning pain in the throat.

55. Pain in the liver with urticaria, congestion of the liver.

56. Eruptions on the abdomen. Sensation as if stone in the abdomen. Pain in the abdomen better by bending double and by lying on the abdomen. Distension of abdomen during chill and feeling of inactivity. Bilious stools.

57. Discolouration of the face:Bluish circle around the eyes, brown lips, sickly sallow face, pale. Expression anxious, stupid and sunken. Perspiration on the face and swelling of the face.

58. Vision as if hair is hung before the sight and must be wiped away. Redness of the eyes, conjunctiva full of dark vessels. Discoloration yellow of the eyes and downcast eyes.

59. Congestion of the head.

60. Taste bitter, slimy and sticky after taste. Cold sensation of the tongue. Tongue:Discoloration of the tongue:bluish, white, gray, and yellow. Collection of mucus on the tongue, pricking at the tip.

61. Blood oozes from the mucous membrane of the mouth. Increased salivation and bad odour from the mouth.

62. Suppressed menses.

63. Troublesome erections in the morning.

64. Urine frothy and scanty in the morning.

65. Painless haemorrhage.

66. Vesicular eruption on the skin with itching.

67. Creeping chilliness in the evening, descending, < 3 p.m.-10 p.m., < uncovering and undressing.

68. Sleep:waking frequently from pain and shocks through the body, unrefreshing.

69. Yawning during chill. Burning pain in the limbs during chill.

70. Wandering pain in the limbs. Formication of the limbs. Tiredness of the limbs. Numbness, trembling and twitching of the extremities. Heat of the foot.

71. Eruptions on the buttocks. Eruption in the lumbar region.

72. Itching of the thigh and third finger.

35. Coldness in hollow of knee. Weakness of the knee.

38. Anaemia. Blood disorganization of.

40. Fainting tendency.

42. Lack of vital heat and upward flushes of heat.

43. Haemorrhage tendency to, blood does not coagulate and passive bleeding.

44. Lassitude tendency.

45. Periodicity every seventh day.

46. Soreness better by motion.

48. Trickling sensation like drops.

59. Congestion of the head.

61. Blood oozes from the mucous membrane of the mouth. Increased salivation and bad odour from the mouth.

62. Suppressed menses.

63. Troublesome erections in the morning.

64. Urine frothy and scanty in the morning.

65. Painless haemorrhage.

66. Vesicular eruption on the skin with itching.

67. Creeping chilliness in the evening, descending, < 3 p.m.-10 p.m., < uncovering and undressing.

68. Sleep:waking frequently from pain and shocks through the body, unrefreshing.

69. Yawning during chill. Burning pain in the limbs during chill.

70. Wandering pain in the limbs. Formication of the limbs. Tiredness of the limbs. Numbness, trembling and twitching of the extremities. Heat of the foot.

71. Eruptions on the buttocks. Eruption in the lumbar region.

72. Itching of the thigh and third finger.

2. PAIN:PRESSING:BETWEEN TOP OF HIP, AND UMBILICUS, ON A SPOT, STANDING AGG, LYING ON SIDE OR BACK, FILLING CHEST OR MAKING ABDOMINAL MUSCLES TENSE, ALSO PAINFUL TO EXTERNAL PRESSURE.

3. URINE ODOR OF BURNT HORN.

4. Red discolouration of the face during sleep.

5. Stitching pain in the tongue. Prickling at tongue tip like a hundred needles, swelling tongue fills the whole mouth, papillae on the tongue erect.

6. Nose:burning and ulcers of the posterior nares, polyps, coryza. Pain in the left side.

7. Arthritic, gouty, rheumatic inflammation of the eye.

8. Worms:Ascarides, oxyuris vermicularis, pinworms.

9. Oppression in the abdomen as from fear or anxiety. Crampy pain in the abdomen and vomiting.

10. Easy haemorrhage of the gums. Mouth pain as if tongue is pressing with teeth.

11. Expectoration bloody, spitting of blood, yellow discolouration.

12. Asthmatic respiration.

13. Hoarseness of voice.

14. Menses profuse.

15. Urine clear as water and odour of burnt horn.

16. Bleeding from urethra.

17. Catarrh, mucous secretions increased.

18. Lassitude tendency. Scurvy.

19. Weakness, enervation, exhaustion, prostration, infirmity.

20. Convulsions.

21. Overpowering sleepiness after dinner and after eating.

key_symptoms:
1. Coryza:Annual hay fever. Itching, crawling and tickling inside the nose. Salivation during coryza.

2. PAIN IN THE FOOT IN THE NOON. BURINING PAIN IN THE HIP EXTENDING TO THE HEEL.

3. FACE, PAIN ACHING, PROSOPALGIA EXTENDING TO SHOULDERS AND PUBIS. PICKING PAIN AT POINT OF CHIN. ULCERS UNDER THE NOSE.

4. VISION:SPOTS FLOATING AND LUMINOUS UNDULATING, WAVING, LUMINOUS OPENINGS HE SEES. EYE CONDYLOMATA, WARTS SCLEROTICS, ITCHING OF CONJUNCTIVAE LOOK UPWARD CANNOT.

5. HEAD PAIN IN THE OCCIPUT EXTENDING TO RIGHT EYES CILIARY REGION, DEEP SEATED PAIN AT THE SIDES.

6. KIDNEY PAIN:BORING EXTENDING FROM LEFT ILIUM TO PUBIS IN WOMEN. Urine has sediment like red brick dust.

7. ABDOMEN:PAIN:DURING FEVER, BURNING IN HYPOGASTRIUM; COUGH, AFTER, PAIN DRAGGING BEARING DOWN DIARRHOEA DURING, PAIN PRICKING IN SPLEEN.

8. THROAT PAIN, GENERAL EXPECTORATION AFTER. EXPECTORATION:ASH COLOURED SPOTS, BLUE AND WHITE ALTERNATELY.

9. ITCHING OF THE PALATE AND BURNING.

10. PAIN IN THE SPERMATIC CORD AFTER COITION AND EMBRACE.

11. HEAVINESS AND TIRED WRIST.

12. FORMICATION IN THE LUMBAR REGION EXTENDING TO THE SHOULDERS. HEAT IN THE LUMBAR REGION EXTENDING TO FACE. BACK PAIN STITCHING, SHOOTING IN LUMBAR REGION ON SNEEZING.

13. Pulse is frequent, accelerated, elevated, exalted, fast, innumerable and rapid.

14. Eruptions:Eczema at mouth corners, chest.

15. Nose:dryness inside, sneezing and burning pain at the root of the nose. Catarrh from cold.

16. Ear:purulent discharge and boring pain in the ears.

17. Eye pain when looking steadily and fixedly.

18. Stomacace, cancrum oris, ulcerative stomatitis. Cracks, ulcers, excoriations and eruptions at corners of mouth

19. Pain in the uterus < before menses.

20. Itching of the limbs.

21. Cyanosis during fever.

22. Dentition difficult.

23. Formication of external parts, twitching.

24. Pain in the glands and wandering pains.

25. Aversion:pickles, salt or salty food, sour acids. Desires:sour acids.

26. Sleeplessness in children, waking from nausea, yawning.

27. Ascending heat at night, chill before midnight.

28. Perspiration with dyspnoea, < motion.

29. Erysipelas from right to left.

30. Loss of smell. Discharge foetid purulent, bluish, green, white and watery, red discolouration of the nose, crusts, adenoids.

31. Boring fingers in the ears. Eruptions around and behind the ears. Noises as bells are ringing in the ears. Itching and burning of external ears.

32. Vision, sees colour before the eyes, glittering objects, dim and foggy. Scrofulous inflammation of the eyelids in infants. Photophobia in the evening, pupils are dilated and twitching of the lids.

33. Head pain in the forehead above the right eye, undulating waves of forehead.

34. Vertigo aggravated on rising from bed.

35. Head:pustules, formication at the temples, itching of scalp and sensation of numbness.

36. Hair:Alopecia, greasy and painful when touched at roots.

37. Dragging pain in the bladder after urination.

38. Stools bloody and green colour, hard first and then liquid. Diarrhoea:in nursing children, during dentition. Burning pain in the rectum < after stool.

39. Sensation of something alive in the abdomen, sensation of movement in abdomen. Heat in the inguinal region and rumbling noises in abdomen.

40. Eructation ineffectual and incomplete.

41. Nausea:during pain in abdomen, nausea < after sleep. Frothy vomiting

42. Thirst in morning on waking.

43. Sensation of obstruction in the throat on swallowing. Burning in the esophagus.

44. Taste:water tastes bad, bitter on waking, food tastes insipid watery, sweetish.

45. Gums:sore, red discolouration, swelling and haemorrhage. Tongue cracked and fissured. Burning of the palate and pain in the sublingual glands.

46. Formication of clavicle region.

47. Itching of mammae, nipples. Milk increased and too profuse. Chest pain bellow clavicle, left side, left mammae.

48. Expectoration easy in the morning. Cough dry in the evening, rattling.

49. Respiration difficult after midnight on waking, after and during coition with perspiration and < walking, whistling.

50. Hoarseness of voice in the morning. Laryngismus stridulus.

51. Aversion to coition after menses. Voluptuous itching between labia associated with increased sexual desire. Menses profuse, protracted, prolonged, dark and clotted.

52. Erections frequent and troublesome, with increased sexual desire, sexual desire diminished.

53. Urethra pain and burning < after urination.

54. Twitching in the wrist. Extremities bandaged as if and weakness. Numbness, ulcers and pustules of the limb.

Hay-fever with annoying itching in the nostrils and roof of the mouth.
guiding_symptoms:
-Catarrhal states. Hay fever.

-Head-Itchingm falling off of hair; roots of hair painful.

-Pain in occiput extends to right ciliary region.

-Deep seated pain in sides of head.

-Ears-Burning, itching in auditory canals.

-Purulent discharge from the ear.

-Eczema behind ears.

-Mouth-Excoriated; bleeding of gums.

-Ulcers exfoliations in the commissures.

-Fissures on tongue.

-G.I.T.-Constant (serous) diarrhoea of nursing or teething children [Cham; Calc-p].

-Stool greenish.

-Burning at anus.

-Respiratory system-Hay-fever begins with burning, itching of palate and conjunctiva [Wye].

-Sneezing, itching of nostrils.

-Annoying, itching in the nostrils, roof of the mouth.

-Urinary system-Urine deposits present, much red sand [Lyc].

-Male genitalia-Pain in spermatic cord after embrace.

-Female genitalia-Menses too early, profuse.

-Desire with vaginal pruritis.

-Extremities-Burning, swelling of soles.

-Copious offensive sweat of feet.

8. STITCHING PAIN REMAINING IN THE EYE AFTER OPERATION. PHOTOPHOBIA IN WIND. SENSATION OF WARMTH IN THE EYE.

10. VERTIGO > WASHING. **Vertigo as if wavering and floating.

11. Eye:sensation of dryness, twitching right lower lid, photophobia in sunlight, pressure apart > washing with cold water, jerking pain, left side cutting pain, pain  < cold air, strong light, left side pain, inflammation  > cold, lachrymation.

12. Head pain:left temples on shaking the head, pressing pain while walking, forehead downward, left side, one sided, forehead left sided, < cold and dry weather, moving the head, before menses, > cold application, motion, open air. 13. Desire to wash face in cold water.

14. Coryza with fluent discharge or dry.

15. Hearing is acute to sound of crumbling of paper. Hearing impaired as if leaf or membrane before ear. Ear discharge after scarlatina. Noises (roaring, rumbling) in the ear during menses. Ear pain:during chill and in cold weather, pressing pain inside the meatus pain extending to the jaw > sitting < waking and walking. Tension inside the ear.

16. Epistaxis from blowing the nose, dark blood.

17. Face:Pain > walking in open air, cold applications. Lock jaw, numbness of the jaw. Face cold and bluish red discolouration during chill .

18. Smell acute, sensitive to strong odors. Breath seems hot inside the nose, itching and tingling in the nose. Left sided obstruction and pain in the root of the nose. Violent sneezing, forcible and ineffectual efforts.

19. Hearing:distant sounds and voices seem, impaired after measles, from paralysis of auditory nerve and nervousness
Red halo before the eyes.

20. Eye:redness from hiccough, as if cold air blown in the canthi, glaucoma, injury to eye from complication of eye surgery, starring, warmth sensation, tired sensation thickening of cornea, stiffness of eye balls, pupils dilated, pulsations.

21. Sensation of something alive in the head, as if brain is loose. Jerking the head backward. Head < warm covering, > cold washing.

22. Vertigo:during anxiety, morning on rising, sensation of ascending, intoxicated as if, from noise, < riding railroad, rising from bed and from sitting position, walking, sensation as if gliding in air and feet not touching the ground > washing.

2. STOOL AT NOON TIME.

3. EXCORIATION WITH DIARRHOEA. Stool profuse, watery, painless and brown yellow colour,

4. APPETITE WANTING WITH CONSTIPATION. PAIN IN THE LOWER LIMBS WITH CONSTIPATION.

5. TICKLING IN THE AIR PASSAGE WITH NAUSEA.

8. Dropsy:external and internal from suppressed eruptions and kidney, liver and heart diseases.

9. Weakness, enervation, exhaustion, prostration, and infirmity vomiting after.

10. Uremia.

15. Burning pain in the throat.

16. Coated tongue.

17. Chest:dropsy, inflammation of bronchial tubes.

18. Preventive miscarriage. Amenorrhoea with dropsy.

19. Gonorrhea and tickling in glans penis.

20. Burning in the urethra < during urination.

21. Perspiration after headache.

22. Catarrhal fever.

23. Rheumatism:large joints of upper and lower limbs.

3. ABDOMEN:PULSATION IN THE EVENING AFTER TEA, PULSATION IN THE INGUINAL REGION IN THE MORNING.

5. RHEUMATIC ACHING OF THE KNEE, SORE BRUISED ULNAR (FLEXOR CARPI ULNARIS).

6. PAIN IN THE CERVICAL REGION EXTENDING TO THE ARM AND PECTORAL MUSCLES AFTER RIDING.

7. Internal trembling. Emaciation. Lassitude tendency. Weakness, exhaustion and prostration.

8. Pain in the bladder after urination. Albuminous urine.

9. Weakness in the lumbar region while walking.

10. Right-sided pain.

11. Pain:of the muscles, sore bruised on touch. Stretching of muscles must stretch them.

12. Face:Chilliness, red discolouration and sickly appearance with dryness of the skin, itching, excoriated corners of the mouth, swelling of the lips, right-sided pain, twitching below left eye.

13. Nose:sensitive to inhaled air and pain on inhaling the air, itching inside, burning of the nostrils, sore externally, sneezing.

14. Bladder:weakness, unsatisfactory urination, constant urge to urinate, swashing sensation, sore tender neck of the bladder, pressing pain < after urination, pain after urination and pain in the neck of the bladder.

15. Abdomen:Sensation as if something is alive in the abdomen, as if ball is rolling in, jumping movements in, Pain < before urging for stool, pain in left inguinal region, trembling in the abdomen, pulsation in right hypochondriac region.

16. Urine:Acrid, dark or pale coloured, cast containing- waxy, mucous, hyaline, epithelial material, profuse, specific gravity decreased, sediment- cells, mucous, oxalate of lime, phosphates increased, white.

17. Extremities:Clenching fingers first thumb, cold hands and feet, cracking of joints, Cramps of the hands, wrist and first thumb while writing or while playing piano and violin, draws inward first thumb, heaviness and tired limbs, itching sole, Weakness in the morning and while writing.

18. Extremities Pain:Pain of the hand from typing, piano or violin playing, pain of the thigh < walking, burning of the toes when first walking, drawing pain in the fore arm while writing, pulsating and shooting pains, sore bruised shoulder extending to the wrist, sore first thumb and sole, stitching pains.

22. Heat in the mouth. Tongue:numbness, prickling, sore and stitching pain.

23. Ear:external ear inflammation, tingling inside, itching, pricking pain inside the meatus.

24. Kidney:Formication, sore bruised and aching pain of the kidneys. Urethra irritation, pain and pressing after urination, soreness during urination.

25. Eye:red discolouration of the canthi.

26. Pulsating and throbbing headache. Vertigo.

27. Stools:Hard, Knotty, ball like and dry. Rectum:Constipation with ineffectual urging, Painful constriction of the rectum, rectum sore raw during stool, diarrhoea after slightest indiscretion in eating.

28. Chest oppression sensation, sore axilla, stitching in the heart.

29. Pulsating pain of the ovaries.

30. Male genitals:sore spermatic cord, stitching and pulsating pain of the penis, pulsation of the penis and thrilling sensation in the penis. Chronic inflammation of the prostate.

31. Sleep:disturbed by dreams, waking too early and yawning during daytime, sleeplessness after waking, sleeplessness from pain in the head, sleepiness.

Jan Scholten:
Decay and repetition in the performance of the arts.
They have been very successful in the past and they still have high expectations of themselves that they will be able to continue in the same way, because they couldn't bear going downhill. This makes them extremely arrogant, acting as if they are very important and know it all.
A variation on this theme is that they may be far ahead of their times and create all sorts of things that nobody can understand or appreciate.
They tend to exaggerate a lot as they are too caught up in their success. They are too dramatic, theatrical, or even quite bizarre and the whole thing appears very unnatural and artificial. Or they may pretend that they are nobody special and do their best to remain in disguise, which is equally artificial because there is no reason for it.
They have produced everything they could and now they have nothing more to give, no more inspiration, no new projects. All they can do is to repeat what they have made in the past, but the spirit has gone, it is only more of the same (repetition).
They develop the feeling that many people are against them as the art critics start to criticize their work as being old and boring, the director of the theatre wants to cancel the show because the public is tired of the same old performance, all of which makes them feel powerless. It is as if everyone turns against them and even their supporters cannot be trusted in case they dare to give adverse comments. And so they feel unappreciated, betrayed and abandoned, the world is their enemy, everyone wants to steal his ideas and take the credit for it.
Fears of heights, narrow spaces, performances, speeches etc
Dreams of being surrounded by dangerous powers; reciting a poem; jewelry; bright colours, yellow
**Delusions slow and retarded movements

Or they may pretend that they are nobody special and do their best to remain in disguise, which is equally artificial because there is no reason for it.
They have produced everything they could and now they have nothing more to give, no more inspiration, no new projects. All they can do is to repeat what they have made in the past, but the spirit has gone, it is only more of the same (repetition).
They develop the feeling that many people are against them as the art critics start to criticize their work as being old and boring, the director of the theatre wants to cancel the show because the public is tired of the same old performance, all of which makes them feel powerless. It is as if everyone turns against them and even their supporters cannot be trusted in case they dare to give adverse comments. And so they feel unappreciated, betrayed and abandoned, the world is their enemy, everyone wants to steal his ideas and take the credit for it.

mind_symptoms:
Jan Scholten
It is important to continue to be successful and be a good mother.
They want to combine their creative career with motherhood, but they feel it is all too much. They feel they have enough creative ideas left inside them, but it is a matter of having to keep up the steady flow. And this is not easy because circumstances are against them. Having to take care of the children sucks out all their creative energy. This way they may even regard their children as enemies who are trying to take success away from them. Reproducing success in order to be cared for

They not only have to keep up their schoolwork, they also have to do extra creative activities on the side, like music lessons, or acting lessons, otherwise mother wont be happy and wont take care of them anymore.

Powerless against your mother

She expresses herself either through criticism or through projecting her own desires on to them, forcing them to be high flyers in the arts or sciences. But this has nothing to do with real love and nurturing. And gradually the children will begin to feel powerless against their mother. They can't compete with her use of language, her cleverness and her power. Her dramatic behavior takes all power away from them and eventually they will see her only as their enemy

Powerless as a mother
This may be the result of having too little time for the children because they are too caught up in their creative career or because they didn't receive much care themselves when they were little and therefore feel unable to cope with children. Because they feel they haven't given enough love to their children, they tend to compensate by giving them anything they ask for, which in turn leads to a feeling of powerlessness later on, when they dare not deny their ever-growing demands.

Dwindling talents leads to self-pity
They are very sensitive to criticism, especially where their way of handling motherhood is concerned and also to criticism of their artistic achievements. They tend to be easily insulted, feeling that they are being treated unfairly, always afraid of being pushed aside.

As soon as they feel that appreciation of their talents is waning, they become quite pessimistic and start to wallow in self-pity. They don't want to meet other people anymore because they will only be trodden on. They usually don't show their unhappiness

Fear of heights, narrow spaces, performances, speeches, alone, water, danger

Dreams of heights, falling, water, sea, waves, drowning, children, mother, disease and death of friends and relations, cutting of his finger

mind_symptoms:
Fretfulness
Irritability

Jan Scholten
Delusion that others will think they are guilty.

The original situation often is one where they have been accused of something in the presence of other people.

They quickly have the feeling that they are making mistakes and that others are always observing them. Even the slightest criticism immediately makes them feel that they have made a serious mistake. When the parents ask them to do something they get very upset and angry, because they feel that they should have thought of it themselves. One patient had the delusion that there were eyes staring at her from all sides. They feel accused, rightly or wrongly.

A variation on the theme is the feeling that others will think that they are aggressive. They feel wrongly accused, which makes them extremely angry. This extreme sensitivity makes them react in an irritable fashion with anybody and anything, and so others soon learn to leave them well alone. This causes an even greater feeling of isolation and guilt. They feel they have done everything wrong, otherwise they wouldn't have been left on their own like that. In extreme cases they are afraid that others will think they are mad.

Another variation is that they feel that others will think they are too selfish. The mistakes they make are, in their own eyes, often due to negligence. They are too preoccupied with themselves, they follow their own instincts and passions to such a degree that they forget to think of others.

They are nervous, restless and constantly busy

mind_symptoms:
Jan Scholten

An uncertain little girl

She feels very uncertain, as if she is still a little girl and doesn't really count. If she promised to be good she would be allowed to sit and watch quietly, but is not allowed to discuss or to partake in the real business of the grown up world, because she is not old enough

The parents and the older children are discussing some important issue, but she is not allowed to join in because she is too young. As she grows old enough to have her say, she is still seen as the little sister who should keep her mouth shut.

She can't stand being seen as a little girl, although she don't show that it upsets them. She gets very annoyed when others console her, saying 'Don't worry little one, everything will be all right'.

She withdraws into her little girl state because somewhere deep inside she really feels like a little girl who is weak and small and afraid to participate in the big wide world. She doesn't like to show this weakness however and prefers to give the impression that she is quite happy to remain in the background because she is not particularly interested in airing her views anyway.

Fears:being abnormal, loss, disease, poverty, future, mistakes, anticipation, being watched, judged on their values, heights, failure, criticism, opposition, anticipation.

Dreams:futile efforts, paralysis

mind_symptoms:
Anxiety

Jan Scholten

Fear that others will see that they need a lot of care and attention

Fear is mainly focused on care and attention. They are afraid to ask for too much attention, to appear too needy and to be criticized for that.

Another variation is that they are afraid to give either too much or too little attention, especially as a mother to her children. They are afraid to spoil, or to neglect, their children. And the fear is especially that, by doing so, they will be rejected by others. It is a theme that can easily be passed on from mother to child. The mother is very uncertain about how to care for the child. The child does not get enough and starts to 'whine'. It wants more nurturing and attention.

On the one hand, the mother would like to give this, but on the other hand she is afraid to spoil the child. And 'What will the neighbors and others say?' She gets angry with the child and sends it away:'Don't whine so much!' And so the child becomes very unsure about his feelings and his need for love and nurturing.

all_sections.SYNONYMS:
Indian Hemp Urticaceae
Hashish, Bhang, Ganja, Birmingi
all_sections.SOURCE: Prepared from the tincture of stem and leaves of the plant
all_sections.PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION:
-It has a chief action on cerebro-spinal system producing intoxication and it also acts on genito-urinary system producing inflammation and gonorrhoeal discharges.

-Cannabis Indica acts as a powerful excitant of the nervous system, perverting the functions of the brain, and increasing both intellectual and motor activity.

-It disturbs the central nervous system in the direction of mixed stimulation and depression, especially of the higher intellectual faculties. Soon after its administration the patient passes into a dreamy state in which the imagination is stimulated while the judgment is lessened.

-There is anaesthesia or greatly lessened sense of pain and touch initially later it leads to unconsciousness.

-Components-
The active principle is a red oil or resin, boiling at a high temperature and called cannabinol. This is a phenoaldehyde of composition OH C20 H28 COH

all_sections.NUCLEUS OF REMEDY:
-It produces a condition of INTENSE EXALTATION, in which all perceptions and conceptions, all sensations and emotions are exaggerated to the utmost degree.

-This remedy has great soothing influence in many nervous disorders, like epilepsy, mania, dementia, delirium tremens, and irritable reflexes.

-It is adapted to diseases of drunkards, of a neurotic character, and to urinary diseases
Right-sided affection predominantly

Paralysis; with spasms of forearms and hand in flexion contraction of limbs.

Acidity with pain in stomach and epigastrium, extending to left side into chest.

Nocturnal enuresis.

Fullness in chest in region of last ribs.
Feeling in lower lobe of right lung, as if some fluid wanted to discharge itself into region of duodenum.

Jerking pain through left forearm like electric shocks, but without muscular contraction, shoots from the forearm to the fingers.

Stitching pain.

key_symptoms:
China boliviana presents the main features of China. off., but there are some symptoms that are peculiar and deserve separate mention.

1. Generals
Great debility, trembling, aversion to exercise.
Sensitive to touch, to pain, to drafts of air; entire nervous system extremely sensitive.
Haemorrhages; of mouth, nose, bowels or uterus.
Disposition to haemorrhage from every orifice of the body with ringing in ears, fainting, loss of sight, general coldness, sometimes convulsions [Ferr. , Phos.].
Desires sour things.

2. Eye
Violent pain like a stab in left eye followed by itching and tears.

3. Ear
Sudden sounds as of a far-off landslide, and detonation of cannon, in right ear.
Whistling sound in right ear, at night.
Sounds in left ear as of ringing of bells, at night.
Sounds like humming of bees in left ear, and as of blowing of a trumpet, at night.
Deafness in left ear.

4. Mouth
Aphthae on inner surface of lips, ulceration of commissures.

5. Abdomen
Excessive flatulence of stomach and bowels; fermentation.
Borborygmus; belching gives no relief [belching relieves, Carbo v. ].
Ailments < after eating fruit [Puls. ].
Colic:at a certain hour each day; periodical, from gall-stones [Card. m. ]; worse at night and after eating; better bending double [Coloc. ].

6. Rectum
Pain as if biting from worms.

7. Chest
Pain in the right lung base during cough.

8. Neck and Back
Rigidity of neck, cannot turn head to right, any sudden movement causes a snap or crack.
Torticollis.

9. Extremities
Rheumatic pains in left shoulder.
Rheumatic pains in left arm from shoulder to hand, also in both arms.
Rheumatic pains from left wrist to elbow.
Rheumatic pains in right foot.
Pains in left knee.

10. Fever
Intermittent fever; paroxysm anticipates from two to three hours each attack [Chin. s. ]; returns every seven or fourteen days; never at night; sweats profusely all over on being covered, or during sleep [Con. ].

all_sections.PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION:
-Chloroform is the best, well-known anesthetic, the general effects of which in arresting sensation need no description. This cerebro-spinal irritant, by its action upon the system produces anaesthesia, with rapid muscular relaxation and insensibility.

-Unlike Ether and Nitrous oxide, which require to be administered without air, chloroform vapour must have abundance of air inhaled with it, or asphyxia results. Its most noteworthy effect is complete relaxation of all the voluntary muscles of the body. It may cause death by paralyzing the respiration or the heart.

-Toxic effects:
Loss of sensibility and complete muscular relaxation.
Very weak and quick pulse.
Weak, shallow or stertorous breathing.

-Use contraindicated:
- In fatty degeneration of heart; in those addicted to the use of spirituous liquors; where there is albuminuria.
- In drunkards, the stage of excitement can not be overcome without grave danger to life.
- Its use is contraindicated where there is brain softening, fatty heart, alcoholism, or albuminuria.

Coolness in mouth.

Hiccough of nervous form.
Nausea and vomiting; seasickness or morning sickness, with much acidity of stomach, and great distension of stomach and bowels with gas.
Burning in stomach, alternating with chilliness.
Pain in region of cardiac orifice of stomach.
Vomiting < after drinking, as soon as water becomes warm in stomach. Vomiting during headache.
Eructations, regurgitation of food.

9. Abdomen
Pain in liver, cholesteric gallstones and biliary colic.
Gastralgia, enteralgia, hepatic and renal colic, with intense suffering, and tympanitis; especially if accompanied by great restlessness from intense pain.
Fatty degeneration of liver.

10. Rectum
Involuntary stools of mucus and blood (bloody diarrhoea), with great tenesmus.
Constipation sometimes lasted eight days, but without giving rise to uneasiness.
The torpidity of the large intestine was such that he was obliged to resort continually to cathartics.

11. Urinary organs
Involuntary urination. Frequent and profuse urination.
Urine dark-amber coloured or clear and without odour.
Specific gravity of urine rather lower than normal; it contained a large proportion of triple phosphates, and traces of uric acid crystals.
Irritable bladder, much desire to urinate.
Voluptuous tickling at the orifice of the urethra, with erections and desire to urinate.
Paralysis of sphincter vesicae, after parturition.
Renal colic during passage of calculi.
Pain in region of left kidney.

12. Male sexual organ
Great weakness and relaxation of sexual organs.
Genitals as if much shriveled. No erections.
Sexual desire, with a peculiar feeling in the testicles, which made him believe that the spermatic secretion still continued, and that the impotence was owing to paralysis of the perineal muscles.
Sexual appetite wanting; the generative functions are in a languid state.

13. Female sexual organs
Hysterical conditions dependent on irritability and spasm of the cervix.
Neurosis of sexual organs.
Slow parturition.
Rigidity of os uteri during labour. Prevents the shock engendered by labour, in very nervous patients.
No freedom from suffering between the pains; she complains much of her backache, or of extreme pain and perhaps tenderness over whole abdominal region; she is very restless and nervous, tosses about and can find rest in no position.
Protracted and severe labours; rigidity of os uteri.
Women subject to convulsions during labour.
Complete paralysis of sphincter vesicae following labour.
Aversion to coition .
Tumours of the ovaries, fibroids.

14. Respiratory organs
Aphonia.
Pain in larynx; laryngismus stridulus. Sighing or snoring breathing.
Dry, hard, spasmodic, irritable cough.
Respiration deeper and slower, constantly increasing retardation and weakness of action of heart and arteries; trembling of hands and feet, total cessation of motion and sensibility.
Want of breath. Respiration almost stopped, so few and feeble; unconsciousness; motionless features; livid lips; feeble pulse, as if dying.
Shock of injury.
Convulsive, spasmodic cough.
Difficult respiration with weakness, after injury. Irregular respiration; one time slow, at another time hurried.

15. Circulatory organs
Constantly increasing retardation and weakening of action of heart and arteries.
Fluttering of heart.
Aneurysm of the aorta.

16. Extremities
Desire to let the arms hang down.
Pain in dorsum of hand and joint of thumb.
Desire to stretch the lower limbs.
Pain in region of right sciatic nerve.
A sensation of fingers and toes being asleep. Trembling of hands and feet.
Convulsive twitching of extremities.
Rheumatic pain about the joints.
Sore, bruised; joints, upper limbs, ankles.

17. Sleep
Insomnia, deafness, apathy, and tremulousness of hands.
Great sleepiness, yawning, and lassitude.
Sleep commonly dreamless.
Comatose sleep.

18. Nervous system
Spasms resembling hysteria, especially in females.
Tonic and clonic spasms. Tetanic spasms. Trismus.
Convulsions, clonic, during eclampsia.
Puerperal convulsions from uraemia or reflex irritation.
Entire inactivity of all the external sensibilities, so that even considerable injury to the nerve produces no reflex motion in the periphery.
Total cessation of motion and sensibility.

A general feeling of warmth flowing through whole body.
Typhus fever, with tetanic spasms.
Typhus fever, with great prostration, delirium, subsultus, irregular respiration and nervous restlessness.

Skin cold, pale.
Unhealthiness of skin, it is slow to heal.
Eruptions, petechiae, pimples.

The name is derived from the Greek word chromos meaning colour.
Chromium compounds often have beautiful bright colours, ruby being one of them.
The metal gets used to put a shiny coating around other substances and to increase the hardness of steel.

Chromium makes steel easier to cut and at the same time more resistant to corrosion and erosion. The strongest steel contains 4 percent carbon, nickel and chromium. Chromium makes it tougher, harder and easier to flatten.

mind_symptoms:
Dr. Jan Scholten
Essence:
AFRAID THAT OTHERS WILL SEE THAT THEY COULDN'T PROVE THEMSELVES.
Feeling of EMBARRASSMENT.

There is a need to do something in Chromium people but at the same time are afraid to fail, hence are quite cautious. It is essential for them TO PROVE THAT THEY HAVE THE COURAGE TO TAKE ON THEIR TASK DESPITE THEIR FEAR, which doesn't stop them from doing what they have to do. They feel that they are BEING OBSERVED and feel EXTREMELY ASHAMED AND EMBARRASSED, particularly if something goes wrong. Small mistakes are perceived as serious crimes.

So they try their utmost to cover things up, to KEEP UP A GOOD APPEARANCE AND A BRIGHT FACADE. They tend to be POLISHED AND GLOSSY in their appearance, mannerisms and talk.

THEIR DETERMINATION TO DO A TASK IS OFTEN ENHANCED WHEN THEY ARE CHALLENGED. This tough and imprudent attitude is not only observed mentally but is expressed in the physical body too, in the form of TOUGH AND STICKY DISCHARGES.

Their dreams too reflect their intense mental state. These individuals often dream about making futile efforts, of paralysis, being innocent of a crime etc.

mind_symptoms:
Jan Scholten

Embarrassed about love
1.These people are embarrassed about the love they feel for someone; hence hide their passion
2.They want to be loved, but are too afraid to ask for it or admit their desire, out of a sense of embarrassment

Embarrassed about their partner
States of acute embarrassment may stem out in the following probable situations:
1.When they assume that their parents may think their boy or girlfriend is not suitable or not decent enough etc.
2.Their partner belongs to a different religion or has a family history of mental illnesses, or some such state of affairs that is better to be kept as a secret

Being discreet about matters
1.They prefer to hush up matters related to adultery or jealousy as they don't want the neighborhood to know about it.
2.They choose to be secretive also because they are afraid of losing their partner if they openly admit about their adultery
3.They are inclined to hide not only jealousy but their selfish tendency and egotism too behind a nice facade

Embarrassed about their looks
This fear of showing anything that is ugly may be expressed as shame about one's own appearance too.
1.Suffering from eczema, being overweight, or even normal things like menstruation, pregnancy, breast feeding etc. may trigger this feeling in them
2.They tend to hide things that are too animal-like about them
3.They dress very properly and conservatively to avoid any embarrassment because of their sense of clothing
Fears:failure, criticism, opposition, observed, anticipation, heights, poverty, ugliness, dirt
Dreams:futile efforts, paralysis, marriage, nightmares < lying on back

Symptoms appear and disappear suddenly and return periodically.

Shooting pain left temple.

Inflammation of brain.

Pulsative, throbbing sensation from region of heart to left eye or left side of head, general fulness of fore part of head, with occasional slight pains in left hypochondrium.

Sudden jerking pains in left ear.

Sudden and pressing desire to stool, with scanty, thin, lumpy evacuations, after tea.

Heavy muscular pains in neck and shoulders and various parts of the body.
Dull, drawing pain at inner angle of left scapula, in the evening.
Superficial burning pains about the middle dorsal spine.
Lumbar pain mostly felt in morning in bed.

Foul smelling, sanious lochia.

Rheumatic pains about the right shoulder and various parts of the back.
Frequent dull deep-seated pains in the hands and fingers.
Dull, bruised, fatigued feeling in the legs.
Severe quivering-boring deep-seated pain in the inner side of the thighs, chiefly the left, in bed.
Sharp drawing pain in the bones and ligaments of the right foot.
Shooting drawing pains about the balls of the feet, painful on treading on the ground. Burning and itching in the toes like chilblains.

Itching, irritation and smarting round the eyes, especially the inner canthi and cheekbones.

Inflammation of the ends of bones from dust exposure
-It begins in the diaphyses, but may spread to the epiphyses.
-First there is more or less intense pain in the bone that comes suddenly, at first continuous, later intermittent.
-Soon after the appearance of the pain there is fever, thirst, loss of appetite, sleeplessness, and dark-coloured urine with sediment.
-Then swelling follows.
-The swelling always develops on one or the other end of a diaphysis, never in the middle of it nor in the epiphysis.
-Swelling has sharp margins with painful to slightest touch.
-Initially the swelling is soft but later becomes hard.
The bone-pain is followed by fever, thirst, anorexia, and sleeplessness; hypersensitive to touch.
Abscesses, suppurations of joints.
Inflammation of bones, joints.
Sore bruised pain in bones.
Septicemia, blood poisoning, pyemia.
Swelling of bones.
Benign tumours.

Complaints of heart.

Suppurative inflammation of joints.

It affects the mucus membranes esp. of respiratory organs; producing ulcerations and stringy discharges especially stringy vomiting.

One is too cold when uncovered and too hot when covered; relieved by artificial heat.
Helps in decalcification.
Muscular excitement at night.

Feels air is passing on and through head on rocking.

Pain in the nose at night with sleeplessness.
Air feels cold inside the nose.
Nasal discharge- Tallow, like a, leaving grease spots on linen.
Feels odour of smoke or onion in the nose.

Congestion and heat of the face after dinner.

Straw like taste of the dishes made of flour.
Food tastes like sawdust. Beer tastes sweet.
Pressing pain in the stomach on swallowing.

It is to be thought of for whooping and spasmodic coughs, especially when the attack comes on with a very rapid cough, and the attacks follow so closely as to almost run into each other.
Often preceded by sensation of smothering, followed by exhaustion.
Face becomes purple.
Violence of paroxysm, even with expectoration of blood.
Laryngismus stridulus during sleep, on and after waking.
Constriction of the larynx during cough.
Throat very sensitive, ESPECIALLY TO AIR. Inspired air feels cold.
Reverberating minute-gun cough.
Continuous hysterical cough; or cough when the patient gives an isolated cough at regular intervals throughout the whole day.
Rough crowing inspiration.
Cough rapid, until the patient falls back as limber as a rag.

8. Male
Seminal emissions in the afternoon with relaxed penis.
Seminal emissions in the afternoon during sleep with relaxed penis.
Flat painful ulcers on the penis mostly syphilitic.

9. Sleep
Always sleeps with the head covered.

Very red flat venereal ulcers, on glans and under surface of prepuce.
Smooth coral-coloured, then dark red spots, changing to copper- coloured spots.
Psoriasis of palms and soles.

2. Feeling of warmth in stomach.

3. PIERCING, PRICKING pains in urethra, with desire to make water.

5. Pricking pains from kidneys to bladder, with increased desire to urinate, stream smaller than usual.

8. Pinching, drawing pain in knees and along lymphatics of legs. Sharp, shooting pain in patella and in bend of knees.

key_symptoms:
1. Generals
Skin pale generally.
Cold sweat.
Exhaustion. Unable to hold the head erect, or stand upon the feet.

2. Head
Bald spot over right parietal bone.
Pain like a tight, narrow band all round head and feeling as if top of head would come off; < laughing or stooping; > by cold wind; desire to be quiet.
Shooting pains > pressure.

3. Mouth
Tongue cold, coated, bluish.
Greenish tint along free border of gums.
Coppery and sweetish taste in mouth.

4. Stomach & Abdomen
Hypertrophy of liver; very sensitive to touch.
Tearing pains in hypochondria, on inspiration, painful to touch as if bruised.
Face pale and enormously swollen, so that she cannot see anything; with yellow stool, pale skin.
Excessive nausea, forcible vomiting returning from time to time, vomits greenish-brown mucus.
Nausea and vomiting < after 5 A.M.
Violent pain in stomach followed by faintness.
Cramping and griping pain in the abdomen at night > warmth.
Violent cutting in the abdomen. Constant burning, cutting pain in the bowels.
External coldness of abdomen at night.
Great thirst.

5. Stools
Greenish-yellow stools, without the least trace of blood.
Stools brown-red, with streaks of blood and tenesmus during stool.
Diarrhoea of children.
Catarrhal purulent discharge with dim vision.
Spasmodic cough < night with little mucous expectoration [Rumx].
Dry itching of skin.
Urine contains bile.
Clonic convulsions.
Sleeplessness three or four a.m., until.

key_symptoms:
1. Generals
Convulsions accompanying constant vomiting and violent colic, gradually passing into paralysis.
Attacks come on suddenly and periodically.
CONVULSIONS WHEN ERUPTIONS FAIL TO BREAK OUT.
Convulsions begin in the fingers and toes.
Convulsions begin in the legs.
Convulsions, eclampsia during parturition.
Convulsions during dentition.
Convulsions aura, ailments before an epileptic attack.
Lockjaw, trismus during convulsions.
In epilepsy aura begins in the knee and ascends to hypogastrium.
Chorea; periodical, with melancholy and dread of society.
Chorea from fright, grief.
Chorea, lying on back amel.
Paralysis of brain, incipient.
Eruptive fevers rubella, measles with sequelae.
Eruptive fevers, rubella, measles with cerebral and convulsive symptoms.
Hay fever, with burning excoriation, paroxysmal cough; tough, tenacious mucus, and fear of suffocation.
CRAMPING PAIN IN MUSCLES.
Desires cold water.
Desire for acids.

2. Head
HEAD REELS WHEN IN HIGH-CEILED ROOM.
Violent throbbing and lancinating pains in forehead.
Pain in left-sided brow.
Violent headache, with extreme weakness, particularly of the lower extremities, or with thirst and violent colic.
Inflammation of brain following disappearances of rash. Child bites glass or spoon, when drinking.

3. Face
Facial neuralgia in cheekbone, upper jaw and behind the ear > by chewing, pressure and hot applications.
Tetanic condition of jaws.
Appears collapsed and hippocratic.

4. Ear
Neuralgic pain behind the ear.

5. Mouth
Bites the glass when drinking.
Constant protrusion and retraction of tongue [Lach].
Grayish tongue.
Copper like taste.

6. Throat
Feeling of constriction in the throat.
Spasms of the oesophagus. Difficult deglutition.

7. Stomach & Abdomen
Frequent, violent vomiting, attended with nausea, frightful colic, diarrhoea, and convulsions.
VIOLENT SPASMODIC, CRAMPING AND GRIPING pains in stomach and abdomen.
Vomiting on motion.
Increased secretion of bile.
Sour eructations.
Great thirst for cold water.

8. Rectum
Slimy brown diarrhoea. Violent tenesmus.

9. Stools
Scanty grayish or green evacuations, jelly-like and slimy, first brownish, then greenish, streaked with blood.
Discharge of greenish, jelly-like, slimy substances with tenesmus, at every evacuation, preceded by violent pinching in the bowels, which is somewhat relieved after the evacuation.
Profuse diarrhoea with prostration.

10. Speech
Speech difficult from chorea.

11. Respiratory
Violent spasmodic cough.
Cough < at night between 11 P.M. and 1 A.M.
Short, difficult respiration.
Respiration obstructed with constriction, contraction of chest.
Convulsive cough and constant inclination to vomit.

12. Chest
Spasmodic constriction of chest while coughing.
Dyspnoea.
Attacks of angina pectoris coming on when excited.

13. Female genitalia
PROTRACTED labour.

14. Back & Extremities
Rheumatic pains. Bruised and lame feeling in the small of the back and lower limbs, accompanied with lacerating pains.
Periodic, spasmodic, painful contraction of fingers and toes, frequently so severe that the fingers could scarcely be extended by any force.
Cramps and coldness.
Cramps in calves with pain in abdomen.

15. Skin
Chronic psoriasis and leprous-like eruption over whole body, in spots of various sizes, without itching.
Eruptions at first dark red and lastly brown.
Eruptions, rash receding in eruptive fevers.

16. Sleep
Sleeplessness from cramps in calves.
Unrefreshing from effects of over study.
Jerking during sleep.

mind_symptoms:
-Fixed ideas:he sees policemen come to seize him.

-Hallucinations of all kinds of figures and grimaces, especially in evening when going to bed and shutting eyes.
Delirium, wants to go home. Desires to go home.

-Attacks of mania; he fancies that he is a military officer; a fancy that he is selling green vegetables; a fancy that he is repairing old chairs.

-Delusions, sees people connected with the law who will seize him, which causes great anxiety and cries like a child.
Delusions, sees thieves, robbers in house.

-Anxiety as if pursued.

-Rage with desire to bite and spit bystanders. Shrieking, screaming, shouting; brain cry.

-Fear of losing self-control.

-Liar; describes some symptoms truly and misrepresents others.

-Clinging of children, grasps the nurse when carried.

-Fear of others approaching. Fear of falling in children, holds on to mother or nurse. Fear things will catch fire. Fear of being injured, would not stay in bed. Fear of falling, of persons approaching, of death.

-Singing.

-Tendency to start.

-Great anguish.

-Weeping, tearful mood from despair. Weeping, tearful mood with pains in facial neuralgia.

-Prostration of mind, brain fag with.

Jan Scholten
Working seriously and denying your own needs. They have a tendency to work very hard and to deny themselves all sorts of basic needs. As if they have to fulfil their duty whatever the cost.
A typical situation is that of ascetic rituals. By repeating fixed patterns and abstaining from eating, drinking or having sex, they hope to get into a trance.

mind_symptoms:
Jan Scholten

-They love to be glamorous and they usually succeed because they are good lookers and smooth talkers. But when something threatens their glamorous position they get very afraid. They will try and do anything to maintain their former position.

-Desperately hanging on to the old ways, they are unable to go with the flow of new developments. It is like a sort of mental cramp, which doesn't help the situation at all, if anything it will hasten the loss of their social position.

-Fears:falling, losing control.

-Dreams:futile efforts, paralysis, falling, driving the car without brakes.

-Delusions:selling vegetables, general, pursued by enemies or police, renovating old chairs.

mind_symptoms:
Jan Scholten

-Morose, sulky, cross, fretful and peevish children.

-Restlessness, nervousness between convulsions.

JAN SCHOLTEN
They are very afraid of losing someone, so they desperately try to hang on to the relationship. They are so afraid of making a mistake and keep such tight control over everything that the whole situation becomes very forced
They are very fastidious and precise, afraid that their child will get hurt if they don't do everything strictly according to the rules. If they don't stick to the feeding schedule suggested by the doctor, their child might not grow enough. They constantly check their children's weight and the height, make sure they don't choose the wrong friends, worry about accidents, in short they get into a sort of spasm about the whole issue of bringing up children.

mind_symptoms:
-Firm and assertive.

-They have an extremely strong will power and hence assert themselves through their work. They are very consistent in their performance since they consider their work as their duty.

-They are very tensed and nervous about the execution of their plans but they don't allow it to affect their work. 

-They are very disciplined which further makes them hurried and tensed.

-Injustice or time wasting is something that makes them very angry.

-Slightest contradiction makes them flair up and shows an extreme reaction. They are so stressed that they actually fight for relaxation. Their feeling of self-worth disappears as soon as they are not allowed to be busy and exuberant.

-Their extreme assertiveness can also lead to failures. They feel guilty if they make mistakes.

-Fear of falling down, of being observed.

-Dreams of unsuccessful efforts, of wars, fights.

-Restlessness, moody.

key_symptoms:
1. Morning nausea & INCREASED SALIVATION DURING PREGNANCY.

2. Sterility from uterine torpor.

3. Faint like weakness, enervation & exhaustion.

4. Dozing during menses.

5. Waking from nausea.

6. Head pain with retraction of head.

7. Tumour of breasts with swelling of axillary glands.

8. Menses too scanty watery; suppressed; with backache; feeling of weight and dragging down in pelvis.

9. Painless labour pains.

10. Granular, pale, reddish eruptions on the labia causing itching.

11. Retained placenta, firmly adherent to the wall any force will hardly dislodge it.

12. Leucorrhoea milky, ropy stringy & tenacious.

13. Menses before proper age. Menses protracted.

14. INTERMITTENT OVARIAN PAINS. Pelvic pains downward as if the viscera would protrude.

-A powerful emmenagogue.

-Gossypium will relieve tardy menses, especially with sensation that the flow is about to start and yet does not do so.
-Remedy is useful in metrorrhagia from atony of the uterus.

-Can be used successfully as an abortifacient.

-It produces strong, regular uterine contraction.

all_sections.SYNONYMS: Potassium nitrate, Nitre. b Saltpetre, Nitre
all_sections.PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION:
-Kali Nitricum acts directly upon the spinal system, paralyzing the spinal cord and the heart, arresting the action of the latter in its diastole.

-It also produces and antiplastic and spoliative effect upon the blood.

-It acts upon the kidneys, and upon the respiratory and alimentary mucous tracts as a decided irritant, in the former producing excessive action, diuresis, the solid constituents being also increased, and in the latter irritation, leading to congestion and inflammation.

-It is a violent irritant to the mucous membranes, causing gastro-intestinal inflammation and ulceration and catarrh of the bronchi with asthmatic breathing.

all_sections.PHYSIOLOGICAL ACTION:
-Kreosote acts upon the lymphatic system, and especially upon the mucous membranes of the digestive and female generative organs and upon the skin, producing catarrhal conditions, with tendency to disorganization, ulceration, and destruction of he parts involved.

-It is an irritant causing destruction of mucous membranes.

1. Great difficulty of breathing even when sitting, lying down impossible. Had to sit in one chair with feet in another.

2. Dropsy due to measles.

3. Anasarca with suppression of urine.

4. Leg burst at several places.

5. Prostatic enlargement.
all_sections.NUCLEUS OF REMEDY: -Deranged portal circulation.
all_sections.CLINICAL: DROPSY, Ascites, Anasarca, Vesical calculi.

key_symptoms:
1. Pain in right eye extending to right temple.

2. Headache in outer half-right eyebrow, dull fontal headache, worse in spot over left eye.

3. Continued sweat on scalp.

4. Flatus seems to accumulate in rectum, causes desire for stool and fears to pass flatus lest stool should also pass.

5. Tingling of skin of face & conjunctiva.

6. Disposition to hawk from cough.

7. Tickling in larynx at night two a.m. three a.m. > while lying on back.

8. Cough with tickling in throat and soreness of chest; worse 2 to 3 A.M.; better lying on back.

9. Fine stinging rash right side of scrotum, lasting one day.

10. Tightness under sternum worse bringing shoulders forward, tickling under sternum.

11. Pimples on buttocks, nates on right side like sore blisters.

12. A sensation of tiredness all through pelvic viscera, even in perineum.

13. Itching of the index finger, metacarpal end of first, left phalanx.
