key_symptoms:
1. MIND
Anxiety in evening < in bed with sadness.
Aversion to hugs with oppressive sensation in chest, shaving, to wind.
Desires black colours.
Aversion to company <, thinks people are unpredictable.

2. GENERALS
Tendency to faint in church in evening, midnight, going to toilet.
Desire for apple juice, cold, green bananas, champagne.

3. HEAD
Headache from strong odors, exhaust gases.
Headache localized in forehead in afternoon with cramp in cervical region with, extending to skull, above left eye, > siesta, open air.
Headache with sensation of ball in head, enlarged sensation as if brain is hanging over eyes.
Vertigo < evening, church, on rising with emptiness in stomach.
Sensation of lightness, as from lack of air.
Perspiration on scalp & occiput during headache.
Pressure on left side after right sided headache.
Continued sweat on scalp of highmore, maxillary sinuses.

4. MOUTH
Chewing motion of jaw is difficult.
Dryness of lips with emptiness in stomach.
Persistent sensation of dryness in mouth extending to oesophagus.
Grayish white discolouration of tongue with red spots on palate.
, Chewing motion of jaw difficult due to apthae on lips.
Loss of taste with inflammation of sinuses.
Insipid, watery, flat taste > sweets.
Apathae in mouth with white edges.
Persistent sensation of dryness in mouth extending to oesophagus.
Vesicular eruptions on palate with itches.
Pain in tongue on protruding it out.
Bitter taste in mouth in afternoon with pressure in stomach, mealy taste in morning.

5. THROAT
Dryness of throat > in open air.
Irritation of glottis, vocal cords.
Sensation of lump, plug < while swallowing, > eating with nausea.

6. TEETH
Pain in right upper teeth with inflammation of sinuses < cold drinks, > warm water.
Wandering pain in teeth from ten p.m. - midnight.
Teeth sensitive, tender to change in temperature.

7. FACE
Heat of face with pains in cervical region.
Pain in cheek > warmth.
Prosopalgia, extending to articulation of joints.

8. NOSE
Sensitive to odour of chlor, exhaust gas in city, fuel, strange odors.
Coryza with fluent discharge in morning, from odors, with pain in teeth & redness of eyes.
Catarrh of nose extending to antrum.
Sensitive to odour like chlorine, exhaust gas, fuel, strange odors etc.

9. EAR
Chirping noises in ear on blowing of nose.
Orgasm of blood to right ear.
Pain in right ear with right sided headache < when yawning.
Hearing impaired as if from cotton in ear > motion of jaw.

10. EYE
Stopped sensation of left eye in morning.
Accommodation:contours appear stronger.
Blurred vision as through a milky layer.
Burning, smarting, biting pain in inner canthi.
Tearing pain in eye during headache.
Bluish circles around the eyes with brown spots.
Blurred letters as if milky layer.
Black & red spots floating before the eyes.
Green halo around the light.

11. ABDOMEN
Cramping, griping pain in abdomen from coughing.
Pain in abdomen, as if menses would appear on thirthteenth day of cycles.
Pressing pain in right hypochondriac region, then to left on raising arm.
Emptiness, weak feeling, hungry feeling with thirst.
Eructations before headache, sour eructation after emotions, after eating pastry.
Nausea > after one hour of having breakfast.
Nausea with constriction of chest, with pressure.

12. RECTUM
Loud flatus, reports like machine gun.
Burning pain in rectum as if inflamed.
Frequent urging, desire to defecate during headache.
Weakness, weak feeling in perineum.
Sensation of coldness in forenoon with short cough.

13. KIDNEY
Boring pain in kidney with sensation as if belt around the waist > warmth.
Stitching, stinging, sticking pain in kidney < lying, > warmth.
Tearing pain in region extending to back of thighs.

14. CHEST
Oppression in chest with weariness.
Aching pain in lower ribs in small spots < on bending & turning of body, pain as if beaten.

15. RESPIRATORY
Cough as if allergic.
Cough with sensation of influenza.
Paroxysmal cough at eleven a.m.
Difficult respiration as if lungs is filled with water.
Husky voice from tough mucus > cough.
Itching in larynx & trachea extending to bronchi.

16. EXTREMITIES
Cracking in cervical region on turning the head.
Pain when drawing back the shoulders extending to hips.
Coldness of hands with constriction of the chest.
Cramps in foot > while walking, warmth.
Pain in extremities as from influenza.
Pain in right extremity from backward motion extending to shoulder.
Pain in left shoulder on waking, extending to cervical region.
Pain in wrist extending to fingers.
Coldness of hands with constriction of chest.
Cramps in fingers, fist, foot while walking > warmth extending to ankle & leg.
Bluish discolouration of finger tips.
Cracking in cervical region on turning the head.
Itching in dorsal region of right scapulae not > by scratching.
Thighs & legs feel as if overworked; excessively fatigued.

17. BACK
Pain in back with difficult breathing.
Pain when drawing back shoulders extending to hips.

18. FEMALE REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM
Aversion to coition, with feeling that men around her are laughing.
Heaviness in uterus with rhythmic cramps extending to inguinal region.
Itching between labia < water.
Pink leucorrhea.
Sweet smelling menses.
Tumours.

19. MALE REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM
Pain in right side of spermatic cord from jar.
Stitching pain at root of penis at four thirty p.m.

20. SKIN
Vitiligo, after dreams of white spots.
Goose flesh when seeing or hearing the news.
Tingling of the skin of the face & conjunctiva.

21. PERSPIRATION
Perspiration like odour of potato soup.

22. FEVER
Chilliness as from draft of air, chilliness > warm water bath.
Fever alternating with chills during headache.

23. SLEEP
Light, refreshing but semi-conscious sleep.
Sleeplessness in evening, after going to bed from excessive joy.
Sleep on waking in morning at five am from coldness, at midnight after two a.m.

2. RHEUMATISM WORSE DURING MOTION; SWEAT INCREASES AS RHEUMATIC PAINS INCREASE; MUSCLES OF THIGH FEEL TOO SHORT; LEG FEELS TIGHTLY BOUND WHEN WALKING BAND SENSATION UNDER THE KNEE.

3. SWEAT WARM PROFUSE DURING SLEEP WITHOUT RELIEF; MORE THE SWEATS THE GREATER THE PAIN.

4. NEURALGIA OF THE EYE GOES FROM RIGHT TO LEFT WITH SENSATION OF VEIL BEFORE THE EYE.

5. Sensation as if lower limbs are bandaged while walking.

6. Dryness of hands at night.

7. Burning eruptions on the thighs and lower limbs after scratching.

8. Constriction of the lower limbs as with a garter.

9. Deep seated eruptions in the cervical region.

10. Itching and burning in eruptions after scratching.

11. Drawing pain in the left extremity goes from left to right.

12. Tearing pain in the cervical region extends to the shoulder.

13. Stitching tearing pains in the lumbar region.

14. Fever in the afternoon; fever after eating, after dinner; Puerperal fever.

15. Scanty urine with sediments and mucus.

16. Bearing down pains in the uterus with hot perspiration, which does not relieve. Pelvic cellulites; Ulceration and inflammation of the female genitalia, which is red and swollen.

17. Puerperal metritis after childbirth.

18. Profuse transparent aluminous leucorrhoea.

19. Pressing pain in the bladder region with a morbid desire to urinate;

20. Anxious urging to urinate; Involuntary urination in the morning.

21. Enuresis twice towards morning when in a stupid slumber.

22. Dragging pressing pain in the urethra while urination.

23. Soreness and stitching pain in the urethra when not urinating.

-Warm profuse sweat, which does not relieve. The more the sweat, more the pain.

key_symptoms:
1. Quivering of the upper right eyelid with twitching of the lids.

2. Leucorrhoea during exercise.

3. MIGRAINE; SENSITIVE SCALP WITH THROBBING AND PULSATING IN THE HEAD.

4. Increased mucous secretions which are thick ropy stringy and slimy.

5. Anxiety aggravated on vomiting.

6. Migraine; head confused especially the occiput with drowsiness, somnolence, throbbing on left side; worse coming into the warm 
7. room, when laughing; drawing, pulsative headache.

8. Drawing headache. Pressure, tearing, and shootings in head, especially on coming into a room, with tearing on one side of the 
face and ill humour.

9. Tearing in left hip joint at 5 p.m. better rubbing. Violent stinging like the prick of a needle in fatty portion of right great toe after dinner.

10. Tearing pains in the hip joint, femur, and knee-joint, especially left side. Lacerating from the knee to the middle of the tibia.

11. Symptoms come on while sitting, and better by rest generally.

12. Laceration in the limbs, relieved by motion and pressure.

13. Menses too early too frequent, too soon.

14. Tearing pain in supra-orbital nerve, with heat and throbbing pain in head and epiphora.

It is a very good drug for migraines with throbbing tearing pulsating neuralgic pains in the head and other affected parts.

key_symptoms:
1. Weakness, enervation, exhaustion prostration infirmity aggravated while walking. Left sided remedy.

2. Dull pain in the left temporal fossa, increased by the least noise. Pain in the forehead better by bending forward, return with same severity on standing erect.

3. Sensation as if brain is swimming in water.

4. Blur before the eyes; everything looks bluish. Severe burning in the inner canthus, with profuse flow of tears.

5. Disgust for everything except cold water. Continual inclination to drink ice water.

6. Lancinating pain in the abdomen with an all gone sensation. Sudden intermittent lancination sharp pains in the abdomen, which extend from front to the back, which incline him to bend forward.

7. Sensation in the larynx as though a crumb of bread or some other foreign substance were lodged there, keeping up a continual coughing.

8. Sleep disturbed by frequent dreams; dreams of festivities, sleigh rides etc.

9. Feverishness with abdominal pains, which when subside is followed by profuse sweat.

10. Rumbling and noisy flatulence.

11. Constriction sensation in various parts.

12. Greasy sensation in tongue and gums.

13. Emptiness and weak all gone sensation in the stomach during climacteric.

14. Empty eructations.

15. Nausea aggravated by eructations.

-Very good drug in stomach and abdominal problems.

3. PHARYNX DRY, DARK RED SENSITIVE; SORE; ESPECIALLY AFTER SEVERE ATTACK OF INFLUENZA.

5. CONSTANT DESIRE TO CLEAR THROAT BY HEMMING. Difficult swallowing. Sensation of swelling in the throat.

6. Painful swelling of the sub maxillary and submandibular glands.

7. Coryza annual hay fever, with dryness of mucous membranes of throat, nose and mouth. Coryza from chamomile flowers. Coryza with fluent discharge aggravated in the after noon.

8. Burning profuse and excoriating discharge from the nose. Dripping from posterior nose. Foreign body sensation in the nose. Acute inflammation of posterior nares. Itching, crawling and tickling in the posterior nares.

9. Ropy, sweet, thick and viscid saliva.

10. Itching in the palate.

11. Polyps.

12. Itching in right ear and pain in the left ear.

13. Pain in the inner canthus of left eye extending to the forehead.

14. Acute and chronic granular and follicular tonsillitis especially of right side. Itching in the throat. Sore bruised stitching burning pains in the right side of the tonsils.

15. Pain in the head at 10 a.m., noon, chill during, while moving the head, and with perspiration.

16. Pain in the forehead above the left eye. Radiating, stitching pain in the forehead above the right eye.

17. Fullness in the head after a headache.

18. Dark coloured stools at night.

19. Constipation from haemorrhoids. Blind haemorrhoids.

20. Diarrhoea aggravated in the evening and at night.

21. Pain in the right side of the abdomen below the ribs.

22. Hiccoughs with or alternating with eructations.

23. Thirst during chill and thirstlessness during heat.

24. Heat in the oesophagus aggravated while eating.

25. Irritation of throat in singers and public speakers.

26. Burning pain and heat in the bronchial tubes. Dry cough from tickling in the epiglottis.

27. Hoarseness aggravated by singing and talking. Burning pain the epiglottis.

28. Desires icy cold drinks and cold water during chill.

29. Cold flushes in perspiration. Perspiration on slightest exertion. Profuse sweating at night.

30. Chill and chilliness at noon at 1.30 p.m. Chill from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.

31. Waking too early and too frequent from sleep.

32. Neuralgic pain in the left hand.

33. Pain in the extremities during chill and fever.

34. Neuralgic pain in the left upper arm and hand. Rheumatic pain in the wrists.

35. Hang nails of the fourth (ring) finger. Complaints of the nails.

36. Pain in the back extending to the coccyx.

37. Swelling in the cervical region with painful glands.
